newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade off record highs.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade off record highs.

text.p: 1248 GMT - German shares end bourse dealings lower, off record highs after weakness on foreign markets, but supported by strength in German bond market.
* 30-share DAX closes bourse down 13.61 points at 2,797.03, not managing to hold above crucial 2,800 points level.
* December DAX future down 9.5 points at 2,804 points.
* Volkswagen falls six percent after a U.S. judge's decision opens firm up to higher potential damages in GM lawsuit. VW also says production hit by French truck blockade.
* Veba higher after it said it plans to expand its telecommunications business.
